syllabus.Nursery: English, Maths, Hindi & English Rhymes (Oral & Written Foundation).
syllabus.Class 1st: Hindi, English, Maths & Social Studies (NCERT Pattern).
syllabus.Class 2nd: Hindi, English, Maths & Social Studies (NCERT Pattern).
syllabus.Class 5th: NCERT Mathematics, EVS, English Grammar, Hindi Vyakaran & Navodaya Prep.
syllabus.Class 6th: NCERT Mathematics, Science, Social Science, English, Hindi & Sanskrit.

syllabus.Class 8th: NCERT Board Pattern Maths, Science, Social Science, English, Hindi & Sanskrit.

homework.Nursery: English & Hindi Rhymes revision and trace letters in workbook.
homework.LKG: Maths counting practice and English alphabet writing.
homework.UKG: English 3-letter words and Maths addition practice.
homework.Class 1st: Hindi reading lesson 2 and Social Studies oral Q&A.
homework.Class 2nd: English grammar worksheet and Maths table of 2 to 10.
homework.Class 3rd: Maths exercise sums and Environmental Science (EVS) diagram.
homework.Class 4th: Maths worksheet, English comprehension & EVS chapter revision.
homework.Class 5th: Complete Mathematics chapter exercise and revise EVS notes.
homework.Class 6th: Science chapter diagram and English grammar worksheet.
homework.Class 7th: Solve Mathematics exercise and read Social Science chapter.
homework.Class 8th: Complete Science & Mathematics board foundation exercises.
